package_scope.purpose: this is an evidence-only rollback/no-op package
package_scope.records: this package records required rollback/no-op decision data only
does_not_implement: this package does not implement rollback package tooling
this package does not implement rollback
this package does not perform restore
this package does not implement or execute binding
this package does not authorize native execution, SetupAPI/Newdev, Windows mutation, driver action, artifact access, compile-output access, or metadata parsing
package_scope.requires_audit: this package requires independent audit before any future mutation-capable task

rollback_decision_rules.not_authorized: rollback implementation is not authorized by this package
rollback_decision_rules.requires_separate_authorization: rollback must require separate future authorization
rollback_decision_rules.requires_audited_evidence: rollback must require independently audited rollback/no-op package evidence
no_op_conditions: rollback must no-op if accepted target instance ID differs
rollback must no-op if accepted target chain differs
rollback must no-op if shared container ID differs
rollback must no-op if prior target identity is missing or mismatched
rollback must no-op if prior parent identity is missing or mismatched
rollback must no-op if prior child identity is missing or mismatched
rollback must no-op if operator confirmation is missing, expired, or mismatched
rollback must no-op if SetupAPI/Newdev is not explicitly authorized in a future task
rollback must no-op if Windows mutation is not explicitly authorized in a future task
rollback must no-op if driver action is not explicitly authorized in a future task
rollback must no-op if native execution is not explicitly authorized in a future task

restore_preconditions.not_authorized: restore is not authorized by this package
restore_preconditions.requires_separate_authorization: restore must require separate future authorization
restore_preconditions.requires_audited_evidence: restore must require independently audited rollback/no-op package evidence
requires_exact_match: restore must require accepted target chain exact match
restore must require prior identity exact match
requires_explicit_future_authorization: restore must require explicit future authorization for SetupAPI/Newdev
restore must require explicit future authorization for Windows mutation
restore must require explicit future authorization for driver action
restore must require explicit future authorization for native execution
restore_preconditions.no_op_conditions: restore must no-op if any required authorization is absent

operator_confirmation: no-op if operator confirmation is missing
no-op if operator confirmation is expired
no-op if operator confirmation ID mismatches
target_chain: no-op if accepted target instance ID mismatches
no-op if accepted target chain mismatches
no-op if PID_045E appears in accepted target chain
no-op if VID_045E count in accepted target chain is not 3
no-op if shared container ID mismatches
prior_identity: no-op if prior identity evidence is missing
no-op if prior target identity mismatches
no-op if prior parent identity mismatches
no-op if prior child identity mismatches
audit_and_authorization: no-op if rollback/no-op package is not independently audited
no-op if execution authorization is absent
counters: no-op if SetupAPI/Newdev counters are non-zero
no-op if Windows mutation counters are non-zero
no-op if driver action counters are non-zero
no-op if native library load or entry-point resolution counters are non-zero
access_detection: no-op if artifact access or compile-output access is detected
no-op if metadata parsing is detected

schema_and_status: validate operator confirmation ID exact match
validate accepted target instance ID exact match
validate accepted target chain exact match
identity: validate shared container ID exact match
validate prior target identity exact match
validate prior parent identity exact match
validate prior child identity exact match
validation_rules.safety_counters: validate all safety counters are zero
validation_rules.mutation_flags: validate all mutation/native/driver/artifact flags are false
validation_rules.audit_requirement: validate independent audit acceptance before any future mutation-capable task

audit_requirements.validation_before_update: this rollback/no-op package evidence must be validated before manifest/docs update
audit_requirements.audit_before_commit: manifest/docs update must be audited before commit acceptance
audit_requirements.independent_audit: committed rollback/no-op package evidence must be independently audited
audit_requirements.separate_authorization: future mutation-capable task must require separate explicit authorization and must not rely on this package as authorization

explicit_non_authorization_statement: This rollback/no-op package evidence does not authorize rollback package implementation, rollback implementation, restore, binding implementation, binding execution, native execution, SetupAPI/Newdev invocation, Windows mutation, driver action, artifact access, compile-output access, or metadata parsing.
